name: Hubei Jiuzhiyang Infrared System Co., Ltd
summary: Hubei Jiuzhiyang Infrared System Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, production, testing, and sale of control systems and their components, optical elements and systems, and optoelectronic products primarily in China. The company offers infrared thermal imagers, laser sensors, global positioning systems, command information systems, and command and control systems. It also provides optoelectronic system, such as photovoltaic turret, spectrometer, and industrial testing products; infrared thermal imager and mechanism products; distance measuring and irradiation modules; infrared lens, visible light lens, optical measuring instruments, and coating and custom processing products.
